# NVIDIA Build

> > NVIDIA Build is a platform for exploring and testing NVIDIA NIM APIs, featuring AI models including Qwen's vision-language and instruct models for multimodal chat, coding, and agentic applications.

This platform provides access to NVIDIA's inference microservices (NIM) APIs, enabling developers to experiment with state-of-the-art AI models including large language models, vision-language models, and mixture-of-experts architectures for various enterprise and development use cases.

## Key Topics

- NVIDIA NIM APIs
- Qwen AI Models
- Qwen 3.5 VLM
- Qwen3-Next Instruct
- Vision-Language Models
- Multimodal Chat
- Mixture of Experts (MoE)
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- Agentic AI
- Coding Models
- LLM Catalog
- API Integration

## AI Model Catalogs

- [AI Models by qwen | Try NVIDIA NIM APIs](https://build.nvidia.com/qwen): Qwen AI models catalog featuring VLM and Instruct variants via NIM APIs
